title: Andrija Puharich, the Ossining 'space kids' and the Council of Nine

tellings.quote: he's the the father of kind of a lot of CIA mind control stuff in MK Ultra but he's bumping into non-human intelligences and having these quote unquote space kids in Austining New York channel

plain: Andrija Puharich, a researcher whom Jesse Michels calls the father of much of the CIA's mind control work under MK Ultra, the agency's secret programme of the 1950s and 60s, also came into contact with what he took to be non-human intelligences. Michels says Puharich worked with so-called "space kids" in Ossining, New York, who channelled messages, a story tied to a group of beings known as the Council of Nine. Michels tells it from the work of others, citing a researcher named Greg Malatzi and a work called Mind Traveler. It would mean that a man inside the government's mind research was also talking with beings he believed were not human.
